final: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT COUNT(t.TrackId) as num_tracks, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) as rate FROM MediaType mt JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(rate) as avg_rate FROM media_rates), above_avg AS (SELECT num_tracks, rate FROM media_rates WHERE rate > (SELECT avg_rate FROM overall_avg)) SELECT AVG(rate) as avg_rate, AVG(num_tracks) as avg_num_tracks, AVG(rate) - (SELECT avg_rate FROM overall_avg) as avg_margin_above FROM above_avg
